_note: The living backlog (docs/03-mapping-layer.md §5): field × operation the merchant needs but the current Xentral API cannot do — rendered blue in the Steckbrief. Initial fill from docs/04-backlog-tasks.csv (279 field tasks) mapped to the new-model paths; resource-level gaps (whole missing entities/endpoints) are in docs/05-fehlende-apis.csv and land as entity-level wishes once those entities are scaffolded. A wish renders blue only where the op is actually unavailable; when the upstream gains the capability a live test flips the cell green and the wish disappears.

SalesOrder.reason: The customer's own order / PO number (B2B standard field). Read-only upstream today; a clerk must be able to set and correct it.
On the phone the customer quotes their PO number, not the ERP number — the full-text search must reach it.
Shop / marketplace order number — required to link an ERP order back to its source system.
Support finds shop orders by the SHOP number the customer has.
Technical shop / marketplace order id — today only the shop importer sets it; integrations need to set it too.
Automated reconciliation matches by the external id.
Desired delivery date — core fulfilment field; one of the first things entered on an order. Not writable upstream today.
Sales channel the order belongs to — essential for multi-channel reporting/routing; not settable upstream today.
Carrier / shipping method — core to fulfilment; must be selectable per order.
How the customer pays this order — central to order-to-cash, frequently overridden from the customer default.
Net payment term in days — drives due date and dunning; regularly set per order.
Cash-discount (Skonto) percentage — standard DACH B2B, negotiated per order.
Cash-discount period in days — pairs with the discount; incomplete without it.
Custom field values carry company-specific data — today only readable via include, not writable via API (all documents).
Companies segment and find orders by their own custom-field values.
Reassign the order to the correct customer after creation — v3 accepts the partner only on create today.
Edit order positions (quantities, add/remove articles) after creation — the v3 update DTO carries no line-item write path.
Partial-shipping policy has no upstream slot — the read reports a hardcoded "allowed". Needs a real v3 field before it can be written or trusted.
Postal-code search is a standard phone use-case (shop orders).
Email search is a standard use-case for shop orders — often the only identifier support has.
Header discounts/vouchers (e-commerce) are not exposed by v3 salesOrders — only line-level discounts exist.

Support and accounting find invoices by the customer's PO number.
Deviating debtor account for the FiBu/DATEV export — settable when it differs from the customer default.
Correcting the taxation scheme (domestic/euB2B/euOss/export) on an invoice — not updatable upstream today.
Payment method on the invoice — central to order-to-cash; frequently overridden.
Net payment term in days — drives the due date and dunning.
Cash-discount period in days — pairs with the discount.
Block/unblock dunning per invoice — a core AR control not writable upstream today.
A dunning note for the AR clerk — must be writable.
Custom field values on the invoice — today only readable via include, not writable via API.
Reassign the invoice's partner after creation — v3 accepts it only on create.
Edit invoice positions after creation — the v3 update DTO carries no line-item write path.
The finished ZUGFeRD/XRechnung artefact + delivery status is a missing upstream API (docs/05 #7) — only XML raw data exists today.
Exact open amount needs readable payment↔invoice allocations (docs/05 #2); today only derived from paymentStatus.
Email search — standard use-case for finding a customer's invoices.

Postal-code search — standard phone use-case for delivery lookups.

Product.reason: The consolidated product kind (ADR-011) should be settable directly instead of juggling isServiceProduct/isFee/isShippingCostsProduct booleans — the v2 create body only exposes isShippingCostsProduct, so service/digital cannot be expressed.

WRITE works — the sale price is composed as a separate salesPrices write on create/update. READ is still blue: the v3 read model does not carry the sale price (needs the salesPrices include parsed), so a written price is not read back.
The 16-account tax matrix consolidated into a referenceable taxProfile (ADR-011) — today only the raw taxAccounts embed exists, not a clean reference.
Packaging units (VPE) need the packagingUnits include parsed — not yet mapped.
Live stock (available/reserved/incoming/byWarehouse) needs the stock include parsed — not yet mapped; today the block is empty.

The default supplier IS writable (mapped to v2 standardSupplier); multi-supplier sourcing (several suppliers with per-supplier price/number) needs a suppliers include/relation not yet mapped, plus a write path.
Tagging products (assortment curation, campaigns) — product writes now go through v2, but the v2 tags shape ({id,key,name,color}) is not yet mapped/verified, so tag writes stay blue.

PriceList.reason: v1 salesPrices exposes flat price rows (this entity is one row); the grouped priceList with a tier array needs a composer (ADR-012). Write each tier as its own entry (create/update/delete are live via v3/v1 salesPrices).

Shipment.reason: Creating a shipment + label via the facade (POST /v1/shipments + createLabel exists upstream) is not orchestrated here yet — needed for headless fulfilment.
Support looks up a shipment by tracking number — needs a filterable/searchable upstream list parameter.
The shipment lifecycle status is not exposed by v1 shipments — only sentAt exists.
Package weight is not exposed by v1 shipments.
Carrier tracking events are not exposed — needs a carrier-events feed.

Payment.reason: No payment LIST/filter exists upstream — only GET /paymentTransactions/{id} (docs/05 #2). GET /v3/payments with filters is the ask.
Payment↔invoice allocations (n:m) are neither readable nor writable — without them exact outstanding amounts are impossible (docs/05 #2).
Payout/settlement aggregation (fees, chargebacks) per provider needs docs/05 #8.

StockMovement.reason: The stock ledger (Lagerprotokoll) has NO read API at all — the single biggest gap (docs/05 #1). GET /v3/stockMovements is the ask.
Movement valuation (unitCost at booking time) is required for GoBD-clean stock accounting (ADR-009e) — nothing upstream.

StorageLocation.reason: Location kind (picking/bulk/inbound/returns/quarantine) and picking order drive WMS routing — the v1 list exposes only id/designation/warehouse.

Location contents (product × batch × quantity/reserved) are readable per location via the v2 items endpoint — the StockLevel projection composes exactly that (filter[storageLocation]); wiring it into this collection field is the remaining step. Reserved per location stays unavailable upstream.
Capacity limits (max weight) for putaway decisions — not exposed via API today.
v1 CRUD exists upstream but is not orchestrated in this facade yet.

StockTake.reason: Counting positions (expected/counted/difference with values) live in the counting-list reports — not composed into the API payload yet; needed for the GoBD difference review.
Starting a stock take via API (scope: warehouse/locations/products, key date) — the v1 inventory endpoints exist but the write orchestration is not built yet.
Submitting counted quantities via API (mobile counting) — needed for headless inventory.
Posted correction movements per stock take need the stockMovements API (docs/05 #1) to be traceable.
The inventory key date (Stichtag) is not exposed by v1 inventoryRuns.
The posted timestamp is not exposed by v1 inventoryRuns.
Position/difference totals are not exposed by v1 inventoryRuns.

PickingRun.reason: Creating a picking run by criteria (wave: channel, shipping method, cutoff, maxOrders) has NO upstream endpoint — the main gap (docs/05 #3); execution (start/complete, totes) already exists.
Task-level detail (location, product, quantity, status per pick) is not exposed on the pickLists API — needed for progress boards and pick-path optimisation.
Granular task-level pick confirmation with quantity + scans (docs/05 #3) — today only whole-list start/complete exists.
Choosing the picking strategy (single/multiOrder/wave/zone) at creation — no create endpoint today.
Pick-run criteria (channel, shipping method) are not exposed by v1 pickLists.
The picked sales orders are not exposed by v1 pickLists (only counts).
Totes/containers are not exposed by v1 pickLists.

Batch.reason: Batches exist only as read-only v3 Product includes — no batch resource, no list, no detail (docs/05 #4). GET /v3/batches is the ask.
Batch trace (which goods receipts brought it in, which delivery notes shipped it — recall scenario) has no API at all (docs/05 #4).
Blocking/releasing a batch (quality hold) via API — maintenance happens only through internal web routes today.
Correcting a best-before date via API — internal web routes only today.

StockLevel.reason: No per-location reservation is exposed upstream; /v1/products/{id}/stocks reports reserved only as a product TOTAL. The projection reports quantity and leaves reserved/available blank rather than spreading a total over locations.
Same gap as reserved: available = quantity - reserved is only derivable per product, not per storage location.

The batch split exists on the v2 items path (qualityControlAttributes) but not on /v1/products/{id}/storageLocations. Emitting batch rows on one anchor only would make the grain depend on the filter, so the projection stays product × storage location. A unified GET /v3/stockLevels is the clean ask (docs/05 #18).
The list needs an anchor filter (product or storageLocation): upstream has no global stock collection, so an unanchored query would mean fanning out over every product of the tenant.
